title.zh: Anthropic三年首次更新Claude API：删除三个常用参数，旧代码升级后可能报错
title.en: Anthropic三年首次更新Claude API：删除三个常用参数，旧代码升级后可能报错

current_state.zh: Anthropic released Claude API version 2026-10-21, its first version bump since 2023, removing the temperature, top_p, and top_k parameters and updating SDK defaults while keeping the legacy 2023-06-01 version available.
current_state.en: Anthropic released Claude API version 2026-10-21, its first version bump since 2023, removing the temperature, top_p, and top_k parameters and updating SDK defaults while keeping the legacy 2023-06-01 version available.
